component.name: Orivon Browser
component.summary: A browser that runs applications Chrome cannot

description.p: Orivon is a web browser that also runs applications delivered from a URL. An application asks for the network and filesystem access it needs, and each one is granted or refused by the person using it.
Orivon reads ipfs://, ipns:// and .eth addresses, can send a site or an application through a tunnel, and runs Chrome extensions.
